name: Deepfake Face Swap
summary: Video in which a face region is replaced by a generated one, with a soft blend seam and a check overlay of landmark dots. The form spread after 2017 through open code and phone apps.

philosophy.core_thesis: The face in the frame is a layer, and the layer shows its seam: the style marks where a real image ends and a made image starts.
design_principles: Frame one face at 30% to 60% of the frame height, near-frontal, with even light.
Blend the replaced area with a feathered edge of 8px to 24px; let a faint colour mismatch of 3% to 6% show at the jaw.
Draw a detection box of 2px in green (#3DDC84) and 68 landmark dots of 4px on the face in the analysis view.
Show a pair of frames side by side, source on the left and result on the right, with a 2px divider.
Add a label chip of 12px mono capitals, for example SYNTHETIC, in the top-left corner at 90% opacity.
Keep the face patch at lower resolution than the rest of the frame, about 60% of the sharpness.
Cut the clip at 24 fps or 30 fps and let the seam flicker for 2 to 4 frames on a fast turn of the head.
anti_patterns: Obvious cartoon filters with no real face
Dark moody grading that hides the seam
Photoreal result with no label or check overlay
Large display type over the face

layout.grid_mechanics: A video frame at 16:9 or 9:16 with an overlay layer; the analysis view uses a 2-column split with 16px gutters.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 0% in the frame; the tool panel keeps 20% to 30% empty with a spacing scale of 4, 8, 16 and 24px.
layout.alignment_rules: The face sits on the centre third; labels align flush-left to the frame corner at 16px inset.
layout.container_geometry: Frames with a 0px radius; label chips with a 2px radius; detection boxes are plain rectangles.

font_pairings.note: A neutral sans that stays out of the way of the face.
A mono face for the labels and landmark counts.

hierarchy_rules: Set check labels in upper-case mono at 12px.
Keep text out of the face area.

color.palette_structure: Neutral dark panel colours with one green for tracking marks and one amber for warnings; skin tones come from the footage.
color.contrast_rules: White text on the panel holds at least 14:1; green and amber carry marks and borders at 3:1 or more.
color.surface_treatment: Flat dark panels around natural video; no gradient; the video keeps its own grain.
color.light_and_shadow: The light comes from the source footage; the face patch carries a slightly different colour temperature, 200K to 400K off.

materiality.surface_simulation: Plain video and a software overlay: a camera frame with analysis marks on top.
materiality.border_rules: 2px detection boxes in green and 1px hairlines in seam grey for dividers.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: A 12px feather on the blend edge only; panels have no shadow.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Outline icons at 20px with a 1.5px round stroke for play, scan and compare.
ornamentation_details.illustration: No illustration; the content is a generic, anonymous face in a neutral setting.

motion.transition_physics: Frames play at 24 fps or 30 fps; the landmark dots follow the head with a lag of 1 to 2 frames and the seam flickers for 2 to 4 frames on a fast turn.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover shows the landmark layer at 100% opacity; active toggles source and result.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels doubt: the face looks right, and the small seam says that it is not.

avoid_when: A real, named person would be the subject.
The page could deceive viewers if the SYNTHETIC label is missing.
The content needs warm, hand-made character.

modifiers.how: Replace the real footage with a smudged 3x3 grid and a text prompt as the caption.
Make the whole frame a smooth render with an even rim light; keep the label chip.
Show a still of a generated face with the eye line fixed at 40% of the frame height and mark the artefacts.

pack.why: A thin line family that matches analysis tools and keeps the face visible.

ground.why: The ground is a plain tool panel: the footage is the content and the panel adds only marks.
